description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for the Answer entity, providing data access methods including findByQuestionId.

classes.name: AnswerRepository
classes.description: A repository interface extending JpaRepository for performing CRUD operations on Answer entities, including a custom method to find answers by question ID.

methods.name: findByQuestionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Answer objects associated with a specific question ID.
